pixee.verdict: Agentic security engineering platform that triages scanner findings and ships validated vulnerability fixes as pull requests.
overview: Pixee builds AI agents that sit downstream of existing security scanners to fix the bottleneck between finding and remediation. overview: PrivacyScrubber is a zero-trust data sanitization tool that redacts PII and PHI locally before anything reaches cloud LLMs. Its browser extension injects into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI interfaces, replacing names, numbers, and credentials with synthetic tokens entirely in your browser's RAM, then reverses the masking when responses return. It also offers a web app, an MIT-licensed MCP server for AI coding agents, and offline OCR and batch redaction on paid tiers.
